page.layout: One printed page: a title block at the top (large capitals INDEX, then a title in roman type, centred); below it a sequence of question headings with italic questions and page references flush right; a catchword at the foot right. Show-through of the reverse page (EPISTOLA heading, mirrored lines) is ignored.

main_text.head: INDEX Quæstionum, quæ hocce in libro enodantur.
QUÆSTIO I.
main_text.p: Cur Iesus in Novo Instrumento passim, ὁ υἱὸς τ ἀνθρώπου appellari voluerit? pag. I
main_text.head: QUÆSTIO II.
main_text.p: Cur Iesus in Novo Instrumento se titulo Filii Hominis passim insignire voluerit, ut eo se esse Messiam, seu Christum significaret? p. 19
main_text.head: QUÆSTIO III.
main_text.p: Cur Iesus interdixerit discipulis suis, ut nemini dicerent eum esse Christum, cùm ipse se Filium Hominis passim appellaverit, ut se esse Christum significaret? p 62
main_text.head: QUÆSTIO IV.
main_text.p: Quem intellexerint, David Psalm. 8. vers. 5, 6, 7. & Paulus Hebr. 2. vers. 6, 7, 8. quid est Homo, quòd recorderis ejus, aut Filius Hominis, quòd visites eum, &c. p 81
main_text.head: QUÆSTIO V.
main_text.p: Cur vates Psalm. 8. vers. 5. & Apostolus Hebr. 2. vers. 6. per contemptum dixerint, quid est Filius Hominis, ut visites eum? cùm Filius Hominis sit Christus? p. 105
main_text.head: QUÆSTIO VI.
main_text.p: Quid significat videro cœlum apertum Act. 7. ad Filium Hominis? p. 128

page.notes: The printed line "Quid significat videro cœlum apertum ꝟ ad Filium Hominis?" contains a marginal or inline symbol read as "Act. 7." with uncertainty; the Greek in Quæstio I is transcribed as printed (ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, letters partly worn). Show-through from the reverse page (EPISTOLA heading, "Semper honos nomenque tuum laudesque manebunt", "Vale, vir Amplissime...") is excluded. Page number not printed on this scan.
